title: 第23章 你太娘炮了第24章 心中的雄
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
明烛真人这边，四个女修更是好奇得紧。
小师弟到底看到了什么，能让刚才还气势汹汹的他瞬间蔫了？
“三师姐，”
朱怀素用手肘轻轻碰了碰旁边的陈纤云，“你觉得小宇辰真有那么娘娘腔吗？”
在这个阴盛阳衰的漱月峰待久了，她们对“男子气概”
的标准还真有点模糊。
“没觉得啊，”
陈纤云歪着头想了想，语气不太确定，“小师弟就是个挺正常的男孩吧？”
陈纤云虽然这么说，但语气也不是很笃定，大师姐苏木芷则是一脸的无所谓。
且不说她根本不认为小师弟娘气，就算真有点那倾向，在她看来，也远胜于变成一个粗鲁莽撞、不知礼数的野小子。
而那姓龙的讨厌声音这时又传了过来，
“知道了吧，你已经不知不觉中被改变了。”
“龙师兄！
可我真的觉得...平时没什么不对劲啊！”
南宇辰的声音带着最后的挣扎和委屈。
“我当然知道你没有问题，你要不够爷们的话，当时怎么会在无风崖上救我呢，要不是你，我刚把那株九叶灵芝拔出来时，就被那头狼王给吃掉了。”
“啊！”
静室里，三个女弟子几乎是同时轻呼出声，恍然大悟！
原来如此！
难怪当初小师弟带回来那株珍贵的九叶灵芝时，只含糊其辞地说是在无风崖找到的。

这小子！
竟然瞒着她们跟那头狼王干了一架！
但几人也都颇感欣慰，能见义勇为救助同门，终归是好事。
而最小的朱怀素在欣慰之余，则还在意别的，那株九叶灵芝，师尊和小师弟可是直接给她用来突破瓶颈了，如果是这个龙姓外门弟子找到的话，那算起来，包括之前坊市买雕像那次偶遇，自己和他在短短几天内，已经产生三次交集了！
按某些命理之说，这简直是...缘分纠缠的征兆！
但她朱怀素可是明烛真人的亲传弟子，前途无量，未来是要结丹的，可不想和一个快二十岁还在练气五层的外门废物有什么缘分，想到这，她下定决心，以后要离这姓龙的远点。
这时侦听虫里又传来了声音。
“这其实也不怪你，要知道你可是一直生活在漱月峰，男人比天材地宝都要少，你在这呆了两年，耳濡目染，潜移默化，日常里那些个小动作、小习惯已经...我不说‘娘’那么难听，但确实带上了点姑娘家的影子了。”
“真的会这样吗？”
南宇辰的声音充满了自我怀疑，之前的底气荡然无存，“我...我还以为自己一直挺注意的......”
“但男弟子们的态度不会有假吧，南师弟你也是凡俗世界底层出身的，应该知道在男孩圈子里，娘娘腔会被孤立的吧。”
“是...”
南宇辰的声音低了下去，带着点认命的沮丧。
“这其实是大部分男人的本能，比如楚元白师兄，他那样的君子绝不会因为嫉妒或者流言就讨厌你，只是你日常的女性化气质和动作，让作为正常男人的他，不由自主地想跟你保持点距离。”
这说法当然是龙涛胡诌的，楚元白虽然在他看来是不错，但两人平日没什么交集，对方究竟为人如何鬼才知道！
但现在...只要能打击一下南宇辰的心态，那就什么理由都得用上去。
“而且还有一个挺奇怪的地方你没发现吗？”
“哎？还有？你可别再吓我了。”
宇辰的声音透着一丝紧张.
“不是吓你哦，你看你...明明都筑基成功了，按道理，百日筑基完成，欲火淬炼体魄，精气滋养筋骨，身体本该迎来一次爆发性生长。

再怎么着，也该比我高半个头吧？可你这身高......”
他恰到好处在这里停顿。
“这...”
南宇辰明显被戳中了痛点，“我当初也问过大师姐。
content_en:
On Master Mingzhu's side, the four female cultivators were even more curious.
What did the junior brother see that could make him, who was so aggressive just now, instantly wilt?
"Third Senior Sister,"
Zhu Huaisu gently touched Chen Xianyun next to him with his elbow, "Do you think Xiao Yuchen is really that effeminate?"
After staying in Shuyue Peak for a long time, where yin and yang are in decline, they have no idea about "masculinity".
The standards are really a bit vague.
"I don't think so,"
Chen Xianyun tilted his head and thought for a moment, his tone uncertain, "Junior brother is just a pretty normal boy, right?"
Although Chen Xianyun said this, his tone was not very firm, while senior sister Su Muzhi looked indifferent.
Not to mention that she didn't think that the junior brother was effeminate at all. Even if he did have a tendency to do so, in her opinion, it was far better than turning into a rough and rude brat who didn't know etiquette.
And that annoying voice named Long came over again at this time,
"You see, you have been changed without knowing it."
"Senior Brother Long!
But I really feel like...there's nothing wrong with it! "
Nan Yuchen's voice was filled with final struggle and grievance.
"Of course I know there's nothing wrong with you. If you weren't a man, how could you have saved me on Windless Cliff? If it weren't for you, I would have been eaten by the wolf king as soon as I pulled out the nine-leaf Ganoderma lucidum."
"Ah!"
In the quiet room, the three female disciples exhaled softly almost at the same time, suddenly realizing!
I see!
No wonder when the junior brother brought back the precious nine-leaf Ganoderma lucidum, he only vaguely said that he found it in Wufengya.
This kid!
He actually had a fight with the wolf king without telling them!
But several people were also quite pleased. It was a good thing after all to be brave enough to help their fellow disciples.
While the youngest Zhu Huaisu was happy, she was also concerned about something else. The master and junior brother directly gave her the nine-leaf Ganoderma lucidum to break through the bottleneck. If this outer disciple with the surname Long found it, then, including the chance encounter when buying a statue in Fangshi, she and he would have crossed paths three times in just a few days!
According to some numerology, this is simply...a sign of entangled fate!
But she, Zhu Huaisu, was a direct disciple of Master Mingzhu. She had a bright future and was going to form elixirs in the future. She did not want to have any fate with a waste from the outer sect who was almost twenty years old and still at the fifth level of Qi training. Thinking of this, she made up her mind to stay away from this guy named Long in the future.
At this time, another sound came from the listening bug.
"Actually, it's not your fault. You have to know that you have been living in Shuyue Peak. There are fewer men than natural talents and earthly treasures. You have stayed here for two years, and you have been influenced by it. The little actions and habits in your daily life have been... I don't say "mother" is so unpleasant, but it does have a bit of a girl's influence."
"Is this really going to happen?"
Nan Yuchen's voice was full of self-doubt, and his previous confidence was gone, "I...I thought I had been paying attention..."
"But the attitude of the male disciples cannot be false, right? Junior Brother Nan, you are also from the bottom of the mortal world. You should know that in the boy's circle, sissies will be isolated."
"Yes..."
Nan Yuchen's voice lowered, with a hint of resignation and frustration.
"This is actually the instinct of most men, such as Senior Brother Chu Yuanbai. A gentleman like him will never hate you because of jealousy or rumors. It's just your daily feminine temperament and actions that make him, as a normal man, involuntarily want to keep a distance from you."
This statement was of course made by Long Tao. Although Chu Yuanbai seemed good to him, the two of them had little interaction on weekdays. Only the devil knew what kind of person the other party was!
But now...as long as it can dampen Nan Yuchen's mentality, any reason must be used.
"And there's another strange place, didn't you notice?"
"Huh? There's more? Stop scaring me."
Yuchen's voiceThere was a hint of nervousness.
"I'm not trying to scare you, look at you... you have obviously succeeded in building the foundation. It stands to reason that after a hundred days of building the foundation, your body will be tempered by desire and your muscles and bones will be nourished by energy. Your body should have experienced an explosive growth.
No matter what, he should be half a head taller than me, right? But you are so tall..."
He paused just right here.
"This..."
Nan Yuchen was obviously hit by a sore point, "I also asked Senior Sister before.
